verses.text: Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:

xrefs.text: Now when Job’s three friends— Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite— heard about all this adversity that had come upon him, each of them came from his home, and they met together to go and sympathize with Job and comfort him.
Then Zophar the Naamathite replied:

verses.text: “Should this stream of words go unanswered and such a speaker be vindicated?

xrefs.text: “How long until you end these speeches? Show some sense, and then we can talk.
When words are many, sin is unavoidable, but he who restrains his lips is wise.
My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
“How long will you go on saying such things? The words of your mouth are a blustering wind.
Is there no end to your long-winded speeches? What provokes you to continue testifying?

verses.text: Should your babbling put others to silence? Will you scoff without rebuke?

xrefs.text: Surely mockers surround me, and my eyes must gaze at their rebellion.
“Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind?
I never sat with the band of revelers, nor did I celebrate with them. Because Your hand was on me, I sat alone, for You have filled me with indignation.
Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
Bear with me while I speak; then, after I have spoken, you may go on mocking.

verses.text: You have said, ‘My doctrine is sound, and I am pure in Your sight.’

xrefs.text: though You know that I am not guilty, and there is no deliverance from Your hand?
It still brings me comfort, and joy through unrelenting pain, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.
But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,
If I have sinned, what have I done to You, O watcher of mankind? Why have You made me Your target, so that I am a burden to You
“Yes, I know that it is so, but how can a mortal be righteous before God?

verses.text: But if only God would speak and open His lips against you,

xrefs.text: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:
And the LORD said to Job:
Would you really annul My justice? Would you condemn Me to justify yourself?
(Oh, that I had one to hear me! Here is my signature. Let the Almighty answer me; let my accuser compose an indictment.
I am just like you before God; I was also formed from clay.

verses.text: and disclose to you the secrets of wisdom, for true wisdom has two sides. Know then that God exacts from you less than your iniquity deserves.

xrefs.text: After all that has come upon us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt (though You, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have given us such a remnant as this),
Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.
So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open My mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden since the foundation of the world.”
which was not made known to men in other generations as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to God’s holy apostles and prophets.

But there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the latter days. Your dream and the visions that came into your mind as you lay on your bed were these:

verses.text: Can you fathom the deep things of God or discover the limits of the Almighty?

xrefs.text: O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in the hearts of men, yet they cannot fathom the work that God has done from beginning to end.
Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
The Almighty is beyond our reach; He is exalted in power! In His justice and great righteousness He does not oppress.

verses.text: They are higher than the heavens— what can you do? They are deeper than Sheol— what can you know?

xrefs.text: Is not God as high as the heavens? Look at the highest stars, how lofty they are!
“For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so My ways are higher than your ways and My thoughts than your thoughts.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

verses.text: Their measure is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.

xrefs.text: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
For He looks to the ends of the earth and sees everything under the heavens.

verses.text: If He comes along to imprison you, or convenes a court, who can stop Him?

xrefs.text: What He tears down cannot be rebuilt; the man He imprisons cannot be released.
If He takes away, who can stop Him? Who dares to ask Him, ‘What are You doing?’
To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: These are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David. What He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open.
I was the first to tell Zion: ‘Look, here they are!’ And I gave to Jerusalem a herald of good news.

All the peoples of the earth are counted as nothing, and He does as He pleases with the army of heaven and the peoples of the earth. There is no one who can restrain His hand or say to Him, ‘What have You done?’”

verses.text: Surely He knows the deceit of men. If He sees iniquity, does He not take note?

xrefs.text: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
Nothing in all creation is hidden from God’s sight; everything is uncovered and exposed before the eyes of Him to whom we must give account.
Then I will strike her children dead, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will repay each of you according to your deeds.
But Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.

verses.text: But a witless man can no more become wise than the colt of a wild donkey can be born a man!

xrefs.text: O foolish man, do you want evidence that faith without deeds is worthless?
Who set the wild donkey free? Who released the swift donkey from the harness?
I said to myself, “As for the sons of men, God tests them so that they may see for themselves that they are but beasts.”
a wild donkey at home in the wilderness, sniffing the wind in the heat of her desire. Who can restrain her passion? All who seek her need not weary themselves; in mating season they will find her.
I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before You.

verses.text: As for you, if you direct your heart and lift up your hands to Him,

xrefs.text: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah

Then Samuel said to all the house of Israel, “If you are returning to the LORD with all your hearts, then put away the foreign gods and Ashtoreths among you, prepare your hearts for the LORD, and serve Him only. And He will deliver you from the hand of the Philistines.”
Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
But if you would earnestly seek God and ask the Almighty for mercy,

verses.text: if you put away the iniquity in your hand, and allow no injustice to dwell in your tents,

xrefs.text: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored. If you remove injustice from your tents
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.
Consider now, I plead: Who, being innocent, has ever perished? Or where have the upright been destroyed?

Then he told me, “This is the curse that is going out over the face of all the land, for according to one side of the scroll, every thief will be removed; and according to the other side, every perjurer will be removed.
I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.

verses.text: then indeed you will lift up your face without blemish; you will stand firm and unafraid.

xrefs.text: Surely then you will delight in the Almighty and lift up your face to God.
And now, little children, remain in Christ, so that when He appears, we may be confident and unashamed before Him at His coming.
And by this we will know that we belong to the truth, and will assure our hearts in His presence:
Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.

For this is our boast: Our conscience testifies that we have conducted ourselves in the world, and especially in relation to you, in the holiness and sincerity that are from God— not in worldly wisdom, but in the grace of God.

verses.text: For you will forget your misery, recalling it only as waters gone by.

xrefs.text: Whoever invokes a blessing in the land will do so by the God of truth, and whoever takes an oath in the land will swear by the God of truth. For the former troubles will be forgotten and hidden from My sight.
For a man seldom considers the days of his life, because God keeps him occupied with the joy of his heart.

Do not be afraid, for you will not be put to shame; do not be intimidated, for you will not be humiliated. For you will forget the shame of your youth and will remember no more the reproach of your widowhood.
“For to Me this is like the days of Noah, when I swore that the waters of Noah would never again cover the earth. So I have sworn that I will not be angry with you or rebuke you.
A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come; but when she brings forth her child, she forgets her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world.

verses.text: Your life will be brighter than noonday; its darkness will be like the morning.

xrefs.text: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will come quickly. Your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.
He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining brighter and brighter until midday.
On that day there will be no light, no cold or frost.
Do not gloat over me, my enemy! Though I have fallen, I will arise; though I sit in darkness, the LORD will be my light.

verses.text: You will be secure, because there is hope, and you will look around and lie down in safety.

xrefs.text: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you rest, your sleep will be sweet.
Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
Your threshing will continue until the grape harvest, and the grape harvest will continue until sowing time; you will have your fill of food to eat and will dwell securely in your land.

verses.text: You will lie down without fear, and many will court your favor.

xrefs.text: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will fall facedown at your feet and call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
And I will give peace to the land, and you will lie down with nothing to fear. I will rid the land of dangerous animals, and no sword will pass through your land.
The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift; men of wealth will seek your favor.

This is what the LORD says: “The products of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush, along with the Sabeans, men of stature, will come over to you and will be yours; they will trudge behind you; they will come over in chains and bow down to you. They will confess to you: ‘God is indeed with you, and there is no other; there is no other God.’”
As for those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead, I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you.

verses.text: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and escape will elude them; they will hope for their last breath.”

xrefs.text: Among those nations you will find no repose, not even a resting place for the sole of your foot. There the LORD will give you a trembling heart, failing eyes, and a despairing soul.
If I have denied the desires of the poor or allowed the widow’s eyes to fail,
If a man denounces his friends for a price, the eyes of his children will fail.
What the wicked man dreads will overtake him, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.
Such is the destiny of all who forget God; so the hope of the godless will perish.
